title: Data Backup & Disaster Recovery
summary: Data redundancy setup, automated cloud backups and disaster recovery planning.
problems: Backups are irregular, manual or untested
No agreed plan for restoring operations after an incident
Critical data is held in a single location
delivery: We put redundancy and automated backups in place and work with you on a recovery plan, so that the business knows how it will restore systems and data if something goes wrong.
value: A clear route back to normal operations
Reduced business risk from outages and incidents
